takeaways: Azure Migrate is a free service whose discovery, assessment and planning help you understand what you run, what is ready for Azure and what it will cost before anything moves.
Performance-based sizing and dependency analysis prevent the two classic mistakes: paying for capacity you never use and moving one half of an application without the other.
Migrating in waves, starting with simpler and lower-risk workloads, turns a risky big-bang project into a manageable sequence of lessons.
hook: The hard part of a cloud migration usually happens before anyone opens the portal, because nobody mapped what is connected to what. This episode is for IT admins and decision makers planning a move to Azure, from a handful of servers to a full data center exit. You will learn how Azure Migrate discovers, assesses, maps dependencies and moves workloads in waves.
